name: pick-function
purpose: A local model names the one function, method or class of a Python file that a request in words concerns; the checker holds the answer to a definition the file really has.
examples: which function in app.py handles the retry
find the method that computes the total in billing.py
name the class this description concerns
which definition does this bug report point at

path.description: the Python file, relative to the worktree

description.description: what the function does, or what is wrong with it, in words

name.description: the definition's dotted name as the file defines it (Class.method for a method)
